timing: Declared after all primary local-risk384-candidate and personalized-control outcomes are known. The first experiment failed its >=10% reduction in every check cell gate; its outcomes will not be relabeled. Known data are reused development diagnostics, never confirmation.
reason: Coarse penalty choices leave substantial F/O slack while not meeting the calls gate on shorter-window data. Test a principled interpolation of complete causal policies using a small constrained LP; do not cherry-pick new penalties based on check results.
proposal: For each unchanged estimator arm choose a mixture of its64 frozen penalty tables plus fixed60. The device/deployment independently chooses ONE entire table using known BayId and a fixed random seed. Thereafter all decisions are causal. Expected whole-window metrics are exact convex sums; one realized allocation is measured separately. Randomizing each individual measurement would be a different policy and is not used.
fit: Use the same4 training/tuning fitting cells. Minimize the mean tuning expected calls/fixed60 ratio subject to expectedF andO <=0.9*fixed60 in EVERY fitting cell (display_guarded). Separately fit original_strict with F/O<=fixed60 and M60<=fixed60 in every cell. Weights sum1 and are nonnegative. Never change gamma after outcomes. Freeze the weights, constituent model hashes and chosen headline before new constituent check replays.
headline: Among bay_full_alpha50 and bay_full_alpha500 choose the display_guarded mixture with the smallest fitting objective; numeric-alpha tie break. Pooled_state, pooled_clock_age, bay_state_alpha50 and bay_full_alpha0 are explicit simpler/unregularized controls with the SAME LP calibration, data and actions.
allocation: Primary seed20261025; U=SHA256('local-risk-allocation:{seed}:{BayId}') first64bits /2^64. Sort constituent names lexicographically; choose first cumulative weight strictly exceedingU. This uses no future window end or source state. One table is fixed perBay for all windows/phases. Also report all10 predeclared seeds20261025..20261034, without selecting a favorable seed.
comparisons: For each frozen target fit strong control mixtures across4 fitting cells at expected calls<=target: old326state/two_stage/pooled groups and the SAME estimator pooled128, personalized state64 and unshrunk64 models, each including fixed60. MinimaxF/O objective; original_strict addsM60. Freeze all weights. On checks report resource mismatch and allM thresholds; old-bank exact-budget hindsight envelopes are diagnostic only, not deployed policies.
check: Same known check256/check512, both window criteria,10 phases. Reuse immutable existing perBay policy arrays where available. Only newly needed constituent models are replayed. Report exact expected mixture counters, primary realized allocation counters, range over all10 fixed allocation seeds, paired wholeBayId2000draw pointwise95% intervals conditional on the frozen models, and fallback coverage.
gate: Expected AND primary-realized headline must each reduce calls by>=10% with F/O<=fixed60 in ALL4check cells. Strong-control support requires expected target no worse in bothF/O, >=5% lower at least one, and frozen control expected calls<=target in at least3of4cells; assess same-estimator pooled, personalized state and unshrunk controls separately. Also disclose every contrary comparison. original_strict additionally needs M60=0 in all4 cells. Do not call display_guarded success an original-protocol success.
scientific_claim: Possible author contribution is a validated specialized method of hierarchical perBay integral-error modeling plus whole-schedule risk-budget calibration. Personalization, partial pooling and LP mixture calibration themselves are known. Claim the isolated measured effect and the exact formulation, not a new generic optimizer, a world-first or a battery saving. Continue the closest-literature check and retain all negative evidence.
future_training: A personalized final867-bay test would require its permitted Jan-Jun histories after the final training code is frozen. Shared priors and mixture weights must stay frozen; perBay estimates can be appended using Jan-Jun statistics only. Current work does NOT read those reserved histories or final occupancy states.
